questions.stem: A 32-year-old woman undergoes a routine Pap smear and her cytology report comes back as Atypical Squamous Cells of Undetermined Significance (ASC-US) and she is found to be HPV positive. What is the most appropriate next step in the management of this patient?

options.label: A
options.text: Repeat Pap smear in one year.

options.label: D
options.text: Schedule a repeat HPV test in three years.
